title: Tom's Pocket Money
text:
Tom gets pocket money from his parents every Saturday. He gets five pounds a week. He saves most of it in a small box in his room. Yesterday he bought a new comic book with his money.

Tom wants to buy a bicycle next summer. It costs fifty pounds, so he needs to save for a long time. His sister Anna spends her money on sweets and music. Tom thinks she should save more.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Tom get each week?
What does Tom want to buy next summer?
Why does Tom need to save for a long time before he can buy the bicycle?
options: The bicycle costs much more than his weekly pocket money
His parents will not give him any money
He prefers to spend money on sweets

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Tom?
options: He is careful and plans ahead with his money
He does not like his sister

vocabulary.definition: keeps money for later instead of spending it
a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pedalling
small sweet foods such as candy or chocolate

paragraph_translations: Tom dostaje kieszonkowe od rodziców w każdą sobotę. Dostaje pięć funtów tygodniowo. Większość odkłada w małym pudełku w swoim pokoju. Wczoraj kupił nowy komiks za swoje pieniądze.
Tom chce kupić rower w przyszłe lato. Kosztuje pięćdziesiąt funtów, więc musi długo oszczędzać. Jego siostra Anna wydaje pieniądze na słodycze i muzykę. Tom uważa, że powinna oszczędzać więcej.
